full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the selection examinations of clerks of military courts under Article 32 of the Military Court Act and Article 10 of the Rules on Litigation Procedures of Military Courts, and of prosecution investigators and prosecution clerks of military prosecution under Article 47 of the Military Court Act and Article 5 of the Regulations on the Operation of Military Prosecution Affairs.
